snippet.title: Climb The Backrooms - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Climb The Backrooms, available now on Steam.

Climb The Backrooms (Steam): https://store.steampowered.com/app/3575300/Climb_The_Backrooms/

Ascend through the twisted, shifting levels of the Backrooms in this physics-based horror puzzle game. Use object manipulation to overcome eerie obstacles, solve mind-bending puzzles, and uncover unsettling secrets hidden in the shadows.

Play solo or team up in online co-op with up to 4 players in this multiplayer horror experience, where every floor is more disturbing than the last. Will you think smarter, climb higher, and survive the unknown?

Climb The Backrooms is a new psychological horror game built for those who crave terrifying co-op gameplay and unsettling liminal spaces. Available now on Steam — prepare to enter the madness.
